channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Trump claims Ilhan Omar may have staged town hall syringe attack: 'Probably had herself sprayed'
item.description: President Donald Trump suggested Wednesday that Rep. Ilhan Omar, D-Minn., may have staged the assault against her during a town hall event Tuesday evening in Minneapolis, echoing conspiracy allegations that emerged on social media. #IhanOmar #DonaldTrump #Minneapolis

item.title: Bethlehem site thought to be Christ's birthplace will be restored for first time in centuries
item.description: A cave in Bethlehem, revered by Christians around the world as the place of Christ’s birth, will undergo a restoration for the first time in 600 years as part of a collaborative effort to preserve a sacred site that connects believers to the roots of their faith. #HolyLand #Bethlehem #GrottooftheNativity #Christianfaith #holysite

item.title: Coastal Family Church fights back after judge bans worship in strip mall unit with restrictive covenants
item.description: Coastal Family Church in Flagler Beach, Florida, is pushing back against a Seventh Judicial Circuit Court judge's temporary injunction issued last Thursday, which bans it from holding worship services in a unit they purchased in a strip mall where property covenants prohibit large gatherings. #CoastalFamilyChurch #Florida #ReligiousFreedom

item.title: Samuel Rodriguez launches BeLight Productions to bring the Gospel to Hollywood movies
item.description: The Rev. Samuel Rodriguez has formalized the launch of BeLight Productions, becoming the first Latino pastor to lead a film production company of this level. According to a statement from the press agency El Mensaje Comunicaciones, this initiative #Hollywood #SamuelRodriguez #BeLightProductions

item.title: Lakewood Church staff member killed in Maine plane crash was 'light that brightened our days'
item.description: A staff member at Joel Osteen's Lakewood Church in Houston, Texas, was among those who died in the Bangor, Maine, airplane crash on Sunday. #LakewoodChurch #JoelOsteen #plane #crash #Maine #megachurch #ShawnaCollins

item.title: Red states vs. blue states: Who will gain seats after the next Census
item.description: Newly released population estimates for the United States show that red states are projected to gain seats in the U.S. House of Representatives and the Electoral College following the 2030 U.S. Census, while blue states are expected to lose seats. #Trump #Census #presidentialelection #Congress #ElectoralCollege

item.title: Man paints over heretical billboard to read 'Jesus is God' in viral video
item.description: A viral video making its way across social media shows a man painting over a heretical billboard campaign in California, altering the message to read, “The Bible says ... Jesus is God.” #Billboard #Jesus #California

item.title: Kanye West apologizes for antisemitic comments: 'I lost touch with reality'
item.description: Rapper Kanye West has apologized for making antisemitic comments in recent years, attributing his remarks to fallout from mental illness stemming from a car accident that happened decades ago. #KanyeWest #AntiSemitism #TheWallStreetJournal

item.title: 6 things to know about the ongoing unrest in Minneapolis: 'A wake-up call'
item.description: The Trump administration has faced intense criticism in recent days amid the ongoing unrest in Minneapolis, Minnesota, where federal agents with Border Patrol and ICE continue to crack down on illegal immigration in the Twin Cities. #Minneapolis #Minnesota #ICE #TomHoman #TimWalz #DonaldTrump #GregBovino

item.title: Trump DOJ asks court to pause lawsuit challenging FDA approval of mail-order abortion drugs
item.description: The Trump administration has asked a federal court to pause Louisiana's lawsuit challenging the mailing of the abortion drug mifepristone while the Food and Drug Administration conducts a safety evaluation, drawing criticism from the state's Republican attorney general and a prominent Evangelical activist. #Abortion #Trump #Louisiana #abortionpill #FDA #mifepristone
